subtitle: Two panel types and thirteen reusable UI, data and verification terms

comparison.label: Fenced code block
comparison.note: Monospace text with preserved spacing. Best for trees, source code, schemas, machine inventories and handovers.

comparison.label: Interactive card
comparison.note: Visual grouping with real controls. Best for registers, selectable items, filters, expandable detail and copying.

example.note: Illustrative placeholders. These are not real A7 or Drive resources.

terms.title: Fenced code block / monospace panel
terms.description: Copyable text that preserves exact spaces, tree indentation, code and IDs.
terms.prompt: Show the complete directory tree in a fenced monospace code block, with IDs and indentation preserved.

terms.title: Interactive card / custom UI panel
terms.description: A designed panel with real controls such as filtering, expanding, selecting and copying.
terms.prompt: Show this folder register as an interactive card with Show IDs and Copy register controls.

terms.title: Markdown table
terms.description: Compact static rows and columns for easy comparison.
terms.prompt: Compare the three options in a Markdown table with clear column headings.

terms.title: Interactive table
terms.description: Structured rows with usable sorting, filtering or selection controls.
terms.prompt: Create an interactive table with sortable columns, filters and row details.

terms.title: Card
terms.description: A visually grouped item or summary; a card is not necessarily interactive.
terms.prompt: Show each project as a separate card with its owner, status and main link.

terms.title: Accordion / collapsible section
terms.description: A long explanation divided into expandable groups.
terms.prompt: Organize the detailed notes into labeled collapsible sections.

terms.title: Checkbox checklist
terms.description: Tasks or acceptance criteria with visible done/pending states.
terms.prompt: Show the remaining QA tasks as a checkbox checklist.

terms.title: JSON / JSONL
terms.description: Machine-readable objects; JSONL stores one JSON record per line for append-friendly logs.
terms.prompt: Export the records as JSONL and preserve stable IDs and field names.

terms.title: Artifact / downloadable file
terms.description: A generated output such as XLSX, PDF, HTML or a packaged report.
terms.prompt: Create a downloadable HTML artifact alongside the source data.

terms.title: Source citation
terms.description: A precise reference identifying evidence behind a factual statement.
terms.prompt: Cite the exact original file or provider record for each conclusion.

terms.title: Read-only audit
terms.description: Inspect current state and report findings without changing source files.
terms.prompt: Run a read-only audit first; do not modify or delete any files.

terms.title: Recursive scan
terms.description: Inspect a folder and all descendants rather than its immediate children only.
terms.prompt: Recursively inspect the folder tree and report nested files and subfolders.

terms.title: Provider readback
terms.description: Reopen the actual originating provider after a change to verify the resulting object, ID or revision.
terms.prompt: After the change, reread the item directly from Google Drive or GitHub and report the verified ID and revision.

limitations: This reference does not prove a ChatGPT response can render every control on every client.
Read-only audits and provider readbacks require real provider access.
Example records and IDs are not actual Drive folders or GitHub artifacts.
